title: The W-Structure: Positions and Works
description:
The W-Structure is a theory of space, time and matter built under one rule: zero contradictions. Nothing is accepted because it is customary; every statement must follow from the positions without contradiction, and measurements serve as checkpoints, not as axioms.

This record holds the 24 positions of the author used across the works (change, space and time; energy and mass; particles; gravity and black holes) and the list of works, each published separately with its own DOI: Black Holes in the W-Structure (10.5281/zenodo.24016340) and The Electron in the W-Structure: Spin, Magnetic Moment, Charge and Motion (10.5281/zenodo.24220735).
